purpose: Task book section 14: give one authoritative CPU test record with an explicit interpreter and an explicit tests scope, explain the 81/122/123/141 counts, and explain (not silently refresh) the VERSIONED_EVIDENCE.sha256 drift. No GPU work is involved.
repo_pytest_config: none found at repo root (no pytest.ini / setup.cfg / pyproject.toml / tox.ini / conftest.py), so scope is controlled entirely by the command line

authoritative_recommended.scope: tests/ recursive, excluding tests/innovation_v6_dgsafe (see v6_dgsafe_is_env_gated below)

v6_dgsafe_is_env_gated.finding: tests/innovation_v6_dgsafe/test_wave2a_probes.py imports scripts/innovation_v6_dgsafe/run_wave2a_build_reliability.py, which at import time (a) requires the third-party 'transformers' package and (b) does 'from src.subspacead...' after inserting methods/SubspaceAD into sys.path.
v6_dgsafe_is_env_gated.why_it_fails_in_a_full_run: In a recursive run the top-level 'src' package (repo-root src/, which holds only industrial_ad and utils.py) is already imported and bound before this module executes, so the later sys.path insert of methods/SubspaceAD can no longer make src.subspacead resolvable. Invoked alone, nothing has claimed the name 'src' yet and the file imports; it then still needs 'transformers'.
v6_dgsafe_is_env_gated.consequence: The previously canonical command 'pytest tests -q' (recorded 2026-09-02) now aborts at collection in both environments. The runnable scope is either the explicit 13-file A1 set, or tests/ with --ignore=tests/innovation_v6_dgsafe.
v6_dgsafe_is_env_gated.action_taken: recorded only; the v6_dgsafe test/script and the SubspaceAD vendor were NOT modified in this round

81.scope: explicit 5-file subset (test_freeze_a1_mpdd, test_v4_contracts, test_dynamic_fusion, test_dynamic_fusion_v2, test_dynamic_fusion_v3)
81.why_different: narrowest scope of the four; a 5-file subset, not tests/

122.why_different: at that date tests/ contained only the A1/submission suites; the innovation_v2..v10 subdirectories did not exist yet

123.why_different: this is the same 2026-08-27 run recorded a second time; the authoritative acceptance record (P0_ACCEPTANCE_REVIEW) says 122 passed and this README says 123. The two documents disagree and no third run is documented, so 123 must be treated as a stale/duplicate transcription of the 122 run, not as a separate execution. It is not possible to reconstruct which is numerically exact without re-running the 2026-08-27 tree, which no longer exists.

141.why_different: larger than 122 because more project-owned tests existed by then (RCEC + innovation suites); smaller than today's 253/260 because innovation_v6/v7/v8/v10 and the SubspaceAD-gated file were added afterwards

today.note: all counts above are this round's actual executions; no historical number is reused as a current result

versioned_evidence_check.interpretation: The index is a frozen 2026-08-27 snapshot inside the accepted reproducibility package. Both drifting files were edited after that date (status/milestone text, not experiment numbers, masks or frozen configs). The drift has not grown since the 2026-09-10 audit, so nothing changed in the last two days. Drift in a versioned-evidence index means the index no longer describes those two documents byte-for-byte; it does NOT by itself invalidate any experimental number, because none of the numeric evidence cited in E0-E8 is sourced from these two documents.
versioned_evidence_check.action_taken: the drift is reported, not repaired. The frozen package index is deliberately left untouched (silently refreshing a frozen hash is forbidden by the task book). A formal release must regenerate the index and label the two documents as post-freeze revisions.

naming_note: In the historical record the string '122 passed' is a count; '123 passed' is a conflicting count from a second document about the same run; '81' is a 5-file subset; '141' is a later, larger tree. None of the four is the current tests/ count.
